select DISTINCT(DOCUMENT_ID) from RAW_DOCUMENT_MATCH_SUMMARY where
document_type_code = #{documentToReview} and
flag_match_cd = #{reviewType} and document_id = qs_parent_doc_id

select DISTINCT(POT_STATENO) from nyehms_Sasdb_owner.er_person_clusters_Stage where document_id in (select document_id from std_din_doccs_doc where doccs_doc_id in (select doccs_doc_id from std_din_doccs_doc where document_id = #{documentId})) and MATCH_CD = 'C'

SELECT match_res_id, match_summ_id, document_id, document_type_code, pot_stateno, TEST_TYPE_CD FROM (SELECT t_rdmr.match_res_id, t_rdmr.match_summ_id, t_rdmr.document_id, t_dl.DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE document_type_code, t_dl.TEST_TYPE_CD TEST_TYPE_CD, t_rdmr.pot_stateno, MOD (match_summ_id * EXTRACT (SECOND FROM SYSTIMESTAMP), 1500) rand_order -- just for randomness of ordering and to give simultaneous users potentially different docs to review FROM raw_document_match_results t_rdmr INNER JOIN document_locator t_dl ON t_dl.document_id = t_rdmr.document_id WHERE t_rdmr.match_cd = #{reviewType} and t_dl.document_id = #{documentId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_document_match_summary t_rdms WHERE t_rdms.document_id = t_rdms.qs_parent_doc_id AND t_rdms.match_summ_id = t_rdmr.match_summ_id AND t_rdms.flag_match_cd = #{reviewType} AND t_rdms.reviewed_date IS NULL)) ORDER BY rand_order

select count(DOCUMENT_ID) from ${tableName} where REVIEW_DT is null and current_process_Status in (17)
AND MATCH_CD = #{filterCriteriaForStatusCode}
select distinct(POT_STATENO) from RAW_DOCUMENT_MATCH_RESULTS where document_id = #{document_id} and POT_STATENO is not null
select MATCHED_STATENO from ${tableName} where document_id = #{DOCUMENT_ID}

select distinct(MATCH_CD) from ${stdTableName} where REVIEW_DT is null and current_process_Status = 17
AND ${fileNameRefColumn} = #{fileName}
select distinct(DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE) from NYEHMS_DOCUMENT_CLERIC_RVW_VW
select distinct DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE from RAW_DOCUMENT_MATCH_SUMMARY where FLAG_MATCH_CD = 'P' and document_id = qs_parent_doc_id

select distinct doc_type from nyehms_Sasdb_owner.ER_PERSON_CLUSTERS_STAGE where match_cd = #{p_reviewType} and current_process_Status = 17 and doc_type not in ('ADAP')
and doc_type IN (SELECT * FROM TABLE(get_user_permissions(#{p_module_id}, #{p_worker_id})))

select DISTINCT(DOCUMENT_ID) from nyehms_Sasdb_owner.ER_PERSON_CLUSTERS_STAGE where
doc_type = #{documentToReview} and
doc_type not in ('ADAP') and
match_cd = #{reviewType}

SELECT Distinct a.fuzzy_cluster_id, a.cluster_id, a.match_cd, a.document_id, a.POT_STATENO, d.document_type_code, d.TEST_TYPE_CD FROM nyehms_sasdb_owner.er_person_clusters_stage a, document_locator d WHERE a.document_id = #{documentId} AND a.document_id = d.document_id

select pdoc.stateno pot_stateno from nyehms_Sasdb_owner.ER_PERSON_CLUSTERS clust, person_doc_Association pdoc, document_locator doc_loc where doc_loc.document_id = pdoc.document_id and pdoc.document_id = clust.document_id and dissassociation_Date is null and FUZZY_CLUSTER_ID in ( select FUZZY_CLUSTER_ID from nyehms_Sasdb_owner.ER_PERSON_CLUSTERS_STAGE where document_id = #{documentId})
select distinct FILE_NAME from nyehms_sasdb_owner.er_person_clusters_Stage where doc_type = #{docType} and current_process_STatus = 17
